title: Production prompt skein sampling for quantization profile validation
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Purpose: define and deliver a production-oriented sampling protocol ("skein" sampling) for creating per-domain calibration packs used to validate FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles. The goal is to produce representative, small (10-50k example) packs per domain that preserve failure modes and rare intents, maintain token-length and recency distributions, and respect privacy constraints. These packs will be used by the quantization pipeline (calibration -> quantize -> validate) and tied to automated accuracy gating for rollouts.

Scope and constraints:
- Domains: support tenant/vertical domains and global cross-domain packs. Start with top 12 domains by traffic for the initial rollout.
- Pack size targets: micro-pack (5k), standard-pack (25k), holdout (10% of pack).
- Must surface per-domain failure hotspots (F1 drop, hallucination rate, structured-output schema violations).
- Privacy: remove PII heuristically and mark synthetic augmentations where applied.
- Workload: pipeline must be runnable nightly; incremental updates should support streaming additions without full recompute.

Skein sampling design (hybrid multi-stage):
1) Domain stratification: partition prompts by domain tag, then by tenant where available.
2) Signature sketching: compute lightweight fingerprints per prompt (embedding sketch + token-length bin + recency bucket + response error tag). Use these sketches to map distributional coverage and detect low-density regions.
3) Weighted reservoir per stratum: maintain decayed weights favoring recent but not dominated by recency; incorporate failure multiplier for prompts with known model regressions or high latency.
4) Diversity quotas: enforce token-length, intent-label, and response-type quotas to ensure edge cases (long context, tool-calls, multi-turn) are present.
5) Exemplar seeding: include a curated seed set of examples from prior failure analyses and customer-reported incidents (approx 200 examples per domain).
6) Synthetic augmentation: for extremely low-density rare intents, synthesize paraphrases using an internal augmentation model but tag them; limit to <=5% of the pack for production.
7) Privacy filter: PII scrubbing + tenant opt-out respect; produce redaction map for auditability.

Calibration protocol and validation metrics:
- Quant flow: float -> collect calibration stats -> generate quant params (fp8/int8 profiles) -> assemble quantized model -> run on per-domain calibration packs + holdout -> compute accuracy regressions vs baseline float.
- Metrics: token-level accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE for structured responses, perplexity delta, logits L2/Max-abs drift, embedding cosine similarity (for retrieval use cases), schema-constraint pass rate, hallucination rate (ASR w/ automated checks), and latency distribution.
- Accept/reject criteria: domain-level max of (perplexity_delta > 6% OR token_accuracy_drop > 1.2% OR schema_violation_increase > 0.5%) triggers block and routes to manual review.

Operationalization:
- Packaging: each pack is a gzipped ndjson with fields: prompt_id, domain, tenant_id_or_null, prompt_text, response_text, sketch_tags, synthetic_flag, scrubbed_flag, provenance_url.
- Storage: S3 path layout: s3://redwood-calibration/v2/{release}/{domain}/{pack_type}/{date}/pack.ndjson.gz and manifest.json.
- Automation: airflow DAG to refresh sketches nightly, maintain reservoirs, and produce pack snapshots.
- Traceability: generated manifest includes upstream request ids and links to initial examples; audit log retained for 90 days (extendable).

Rollout plan:
- Week 0: finalize sampling config + small dry run for 3 domains (billing, search, chat).
- Week 1: full pack generation for top 12 domains; run quantization pipeline with fp8 and int8 candidates.
- Week 2: analyze metric regressions; produce per-domain tuning recommendations (clip ranges, per-layer fallbacks, mixed-precision tips).
- Week 3: gate integration into canary rollout flow (console will show pack-based accuracy checks).

Trade-offs and rationale:
- Prefer hybrid reservoir + exemplar seeding vs pure stratified sampling to preserve rare failure modes while keeping recency.
- Limit synthetic augmentation (<5%) to avoid biasing calibration towards model-generated patterns.
- Keeping pack sizes small (25k) accelerates iterative quant experiments; larger packs reserved for periodic full-validation.

Artifacts and links:
- Design doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/confluence/display/INF/Skein+Sampling+Design
- Initial implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345
- Calibration pipeline GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-pipeline/pull/998
- Dashboard prototype: https://app.datadog.com/dashboard/abcd-quant-calibration

Deliverables:
- Sampling service (Python + Rust workers) that emits per-domain packs and manifests.
- Nightly DAG and CI checks that ensure pack freshness and validation coverage.
- Console integration: pack health & per-domain regression thresholds visible in rollout UI.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Asha K: Scoped initial proposal after working session with quant team and PMs. Chosen the 'skein' metaphor to describe multi-threaded sampling that captures topology and edges. Posted design doc link above.

2026-02-23 - Liam O'C: Implemented sketching proto; sketch includes 64-d simhash + token-length bin + recency bucket. Benchmarked memory; reservoir overhead ~1.4x baseline, acceptable. PR: infra#2345.
2026-02-25 - Priya (PM): Confirmed top-12 domains list and customer-sensitive domains to exclude from synthetic augmentation. Added label 'privacy'.

2026-02-27 - Security review (internal): flagged PII scrubbing coverage gaps for email addresses embedded in base64; added heuristic to detect encoded payloads. Security asked for audit manifest - tracking in manifest.json.

2026-03-01 - Eng review: Ran dry-run on billing/search/chat. Observed that decayed weights over-emphasized recency for 'search' where long-tail stable queries matter. Adjusted decay constant from 0.9->0.97 for retrieval-heavy domains.

2026-03-03 - Data Science: Noted that embedding-cosine metric correlates poorly with downstream retrieval MRR for some tenants. Added tenant-specific eval hooks and a secondary embedding model for curated checks.

2026-03-05 - QA: Small-pack validation completed; FP8 candidate showed mean token-accuracy drop 0.7% for 'chat' and 1.5% for 'legal' domain. 'Legal' triggered manual review - next step to run per-layer fallback on high-sensitivity layers.

2026-03-06 - Liam O'C: Updated pack manifest schema to include provenance_url and synthetic_flag. Filing follow-up tasks: ENG-188108 (per-layer fallback automation) and ENG-188109 (console pack visualization).
